title: Degreewise image of the good horizontal truncation total
statement: For an integer-indexed first-quadrant bicomplex M in a Grothendieck abelian category, q>=0 and any integer n, the image of the degree-n component of the totalized good horizontal truncation inclusion equals the second filtration step n-q [def-sp-double-complex-total] intersected with the inverse image under the total differential of the next-degree second filtration step n-q+1.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology
source.place: Tag 015X, second filtration and horizontal good truncation

proof.text: For q<=n apply the boundary-kernel identity. If n<q, on the diagonal p+r=n the truncation inclusion is an isomorphism whenever p<q. If p>=q then r<0, so its target term is zero; its source is zero by monicity. Stability of isomorphisms under coproducts makes the total map invertible in this degree. Both filtration indices n-q and n-q+1 are nonpositive; the second filtration is top at them. Pullback of top is top, equal to the image of the invertible map. Components below the cut use the upstream isIso_ιTruncLE_f API.

lean.statement:
theorem good_truncation_total_image
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    (M : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hM : ∀ p r : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ r < 0 → IsZero ((M.X p).X r))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (n : ℤ) :
    imageSubobject ((total.map (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE M q)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).f n) =
      (M.secondFiltration n).step (n - q) ⊓
        (Subobject.pullback ((M.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).d n (n + 1))).obj
          ((M.secondFiltration (n + 1)).step (n - q + 1))
